source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:

- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

The same net $ amount would still be given away, but this would create a smoother, cleaner, clearer, and more consistent flow of winners

decisions.reason: Changing prize amounts, winner counts, and draw intervals does not change the issuance of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket per qualifying referral mint.
The source changes prize parameters but leaves Chainlink VRF, ticket-weighted randomness, eligible populations, and on-chain verification unchanged.
The separate ticket counters and their reset-after-draw behavior remain valid without storing a numerical sales interval.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or allocation of Small and Big Block tickets.
The About page's prize-draw process item contains the superseded winner counts and sales intervals and must be updated to remain consistent with the new mechanics.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 1 × $500 awarded every 100 sales. Big Block: 1 × $10,000 awarded every 10,000 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

decisions.reason: The source explicitly preserves the net giveaway amount and does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or active prize-pool destinations.
Both prize mechanisms remain active, so the Small and Big Block ticket counters remain valid metadata fields.
The source changes prize amounts and cadence but does not resolve or alter whether prizes are delivered automatically or through a claim action.
The Winners page remains the announcement channel regardless of the revised number and frequency of winners.
The prize-parameter change does not itself remove or modify Aave yield generation; treating Aave as unnecessary requires a separate client lifecycle decision.
